title: fix(metadata)!: an action's removal counts and takes its holders by package over every slot of the name (ADR-0150 D3/D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgGNVRjXhd2cDxMkfDXkkdip)_
epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZRARNYmYKvzfuviP1

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除动作（`action`）时，按"包"数持有者，覆盖这个名字下的全部槽位，包括无对象的和绑定到各个对象的。带包删除会删掉该包的全部槽位，不带包删除时，只要两个以上的包持有这个名字就返回 409，并列出每个包及其绑定的对象。
- 为什么改：卸载一个包之后，它绑定到对象上的动作还留在注册表里继续被读到。两个包持有同名的绑定动作时，不带包的删除会把两边一起删掉。有数据库时更糟：两行数据都还在，却照样广播"已删除"（修订 S7）。
- 风险与回滚：只有一个包持有的名字，删除行为不变；两个包都是无对象动作时，拒绝和报错文字也不变。第一方调用方普查为 0。不改表结构，不改存储行，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 里的 `storeRemovalKeys` 和新增的 `refuseSeveralPackages`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts -t 32352`，预期 16 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，由席位落地（经座位 1 同意，先于 #32497 落地）。

Fixes #32352

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed — a package-less removal of an action name two packages hold, where one or both bind it to an object, is now refused naming both, where it took both packages' actions (the epic's precedent for a metadata-service removal turned 409: ruling 6810963021)
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches `MetadataManager.unregister`'s removal of a package's action (`git grep -n "unregister('action'\|unregister(type, name, { packageId" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'`: no hit)

Claim 6812576869 by `epic:#31527#2`. The seat ruled the row-key option A on the step-0 report (the seat's go, 2026-11-12T02:29Z): the removal counts holders by package over every identity of the name, as `DatabaseLoader`'s row key `(package, name)` and the by-name read (#32244's `refuseAcrossOwners`) do. Option B (an object-aware row key) needs a `sys_metadata` unique-key change and still needs A's refusal; option C (no refusal for two objects, the loader takes both rows) loosens a refusal and takes two packages' items.

## What changes

`@objectstack/metadata`, `package-slotted-store.ts`, `storeRemovalKeys` (the one removal rule the manager, the door's `MemoryLoader` and `DatabaseLoader` all ask):

- **Naming a package**: every key of the name that package holds, object-less and each object-bound one. It was the object-less key only, so a bound action left the door's store and its row (both already deleted per package) but stayed in the registry.
- **Naming none**: the holders are the distinct packages over every key of the name (new private `refuseSeveralPackages`). Two or more are refused with the D3 `409` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, `callerPackageId: null`), candidates in store order. For an action with any bound slot the message adds the read's owners sentence (`packageScopedActionOwnersSentence`: each package with the object it binds the name to, or "no object"). An object-less-only refusal keeps its message byte for byte. It counted only the object-less key's holders.
- For every other slotted type (`api`, `agent`, `skill`, `permission`) a key's identity is its name, so both branches select the same keys as before.

`metadata-manager.ts`: `removalOf`'s doc drops its "⛔ except an object-bound action's slots … a separate card" exception and states the agreement with the row key. No code change there: `removalOf` already judged the registry and then the registry-plus-loaders view through `storeRemovalKeys`, so S7 is now refused at that judgment, before step 1 deletes anything.

`DatabaseLoader.delete` and `MemoryLoader.delete` are not edited: rows are keyed `(package, name)`, so the rule's package count is what the row rule counted already, and the door's package-named delete already took every slot of the package.

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

| # | Call | FROM (main 89d815c5, = phk4r9 1483899c) | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `unregister('action', x, { packageId: P })`, P's action bound to an object | the door entry and row went; the registry slot stayed, served by `get(…, P)` and `list` | removed from the registry too; the other package's slot, entry and row kept; `deleted` names P | fix (a removal now takes what it names) | action-slots "takes its object-bound slot too", "every slot it holds"; match-endpoint "naming one package takes its registry slot, door entry and row" ×2 |
| 2 | `unregister('action', x)`, two packages hold x on one object, on two objects, or one bound and one object-less (no `DatabaseLoader`) | not refused; every package's slot taken; `deleted` announced | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming each package (with its object); nothing removed or announced | narrowing | action-slots "the D3 refusal (409) naming each package with its object" ×2, "one package binds and another holds object-less" |
| 3 | the same with `DatabaseLoader` rows (amendment S7) | the manager's judgment passed; the door and registry dropped every slot; `DatabaseLoader.delete` refused, logged as a failed delete; `deleted` announced; both rows kept and served | the same `409` before anything is touched: registry, door and rows kept, no event, no error logged | narrowing | match-endpoint "a removal naming none is refused (409) … before anything is touched" ×3 |
| 4 | the artifact door's `MemoryLoader.delete('action', x)` called directly with no package, two packages hold x (the same three shapes) | deleted every slot of the name | the same `409`, every slot kept; `delete('action', x, { packageId })` still takes that package's slots only | narrowing | match-endpoint "the artifact door's `MemoryLoader`, asked directly" ×3 |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROL: one package on two objects (a removal naming none takes both); one package's bound action with a `DatabaseLoader` (removed, as before); two packages' object-less name (refused, same message).

First-party census: callers of `unregister` with type `action`, or with a variable type that can be `action`, outside tests: 0 (`git grep -n "\.unregister(" -- 'packages/**/*.ts' ':!*.test.ts'`: `object`, `datasource`, `permission` (`security-catalog-echo.ts`), and `bulkUnregister`, which has no caller). `unregisterPackage` passes its own keys and is untouched.

## Tests

New pins go into the existing shared files as top-level describes:

- `metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`: `[#32352] removing an action counts its holders by package over every slot of the name` (7 cases: registry only).
- `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: `[#32352] an action's removal: the manager's holder count agrees with the loaders' row key` (9 cases: the artifact door's `MemoryLoader` plus a `DatabaseLoader` over the file's `rowDriver`, with the realtime and watcher events and the manager's error log read; three of them call the door's `MemoryLoader.delete` directly).

## Acceptance notes

- One package binding one name to two objects still has ONE `DatabaseLoader` row (the row key is object-blind, so the later save overwrote the earlier). That predates this card and is option B's ground; not changed here. Filed as #32540 under the epic.
- `MemoryLoader.delete`'s package-named branch filters by package itself; it now agrees with `storeRemovalKeys` and was left as is.
